rules: Use 'Tinted Grey' rule: neutral greys must have a tiny green/blue tint (e.g., slate).
No teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) as per forbidden rules.
High contrast for tables and data points.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphism (The 'Tactile' Variant) for widgets: 1px crisp borders (border-black/5), flat backgrounds matching parent, subtle shadows.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard metrics and clear metaphors. Run: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

components_and_paths.cards: frontend/src/components/ui/card.jsx (Override to use flat layout with 1px border, no large drop shadows)
components_and_paths.toasts: frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx (For Save actions & Bug Fix confirmations)
components_and_paths.custom_nodes: frontend/src/components/ui/node.jsx (To be created for Decision Tree 'Wrap Node')

grids.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
grids.spacing_scale: p-6 for cards, p-8 for main sections. Ensure padding prevents border collision.

MIS_Reports_Module.navigation: Sticky left sidebar or top secondary nav (Crystal Glass if sticky, solid if fixed).
MIS_Reports_Module.catalog: Bento Grid layout for predefined report templates. Clear category separation.
MIS_Reports_Module.filters: Inline dense filter schema at top of the reports view.

Decision_Tree_Builder.wrap_node: Absolute positioned UI overlay or React Flow custom node with wrapping dashed border.

motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text color (hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900). Focus rings required (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#064E3B]).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties like 'transition-transform duration-200 ease-out' rather than 'transition-all'.

accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid to every interactive element (e.g., data-testid='mis-report-generate-btn', data-testid='custom-fuel-save-btn').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Data tables must be clear.

media.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts for report generation previews.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not applicable for Phase 1 V1 reporting context. Keep it 2D and highly legible.

reports_catalog.description: Dashboard requires vector icons rather than heavy photography for high density.

instructions_to_main_agent.V1_Scope: Focus strictly on V1 Phase 1. Implement Stationary Combustion Composition of Carbon calc alongside NCV/Heat-basis, Custom Fuel form for all scopes, Wrap Node for decision tree, and standard MIS Reporting foundation.
instructions_to_main_agent.File_Types: Create only .js or .jsx files. DO NOT create .tsx or .ts files.
instructions_to_main_agent.Bug_Fixes: Fix Custom Fuel form missing live calculations / save issues. Add explicit inline validation for missing process types in Process Emissions. Fix Emissions Ledger status rendering for Admins.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts located in frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
